```
def _repair(circles, tol=1e-9):
    out = [[float(x), float(y), float(r)] for x,y,r in circles]
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        n = len(out)
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i+1,n):
                dx = out[i][0]-out[j][0]; dy = out[i][1]-out[j][1]
                d = math.hypot(dx,dy)
                s = out[i][2] + out[j][2]
                if s > d + tol:
                    # reduce larger
                    if out[i][2] > out[j][2]:
                        new_r = max(0.0, d - out[j][2])
                        if new_r < out[i][2] - 1e-12:
                            out[i][2] = new_r; changed = True
                    else:
                        new_r = max(0.0, d - out[i][2])
                        if new_r < out[j][2] - 1e-12:
                            out[j][2] = new_r; changed = True
        # clip to bounds
        for c in out:
            c[0] = min(1.0, max(0.0, c[0])); c[1] = min(1.0, max(0.0, c[1]))
            c[2] = min(c[2], c[0], 1.0-c[0], c[1], 1.0-c[1])
            if c[2] < 0: c[2]=0
    return out
```
